## 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

species <- read_csv("/Volumes/sarahdrive/r studio/BHC01 species analysis/data-3.csv")

# ── Mammals ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Include all Mammalia EXCEPT:
#   - Chiroptera (bats)
#   - Rodentia (rodents)
#   - Peramelemorphia / Thylacomyidae (bilby)
#   - Dasyuridae (marsupial mice / dunnarts / planigales / kultarr)
species <- species %>%
  filter(`Taxon Rank` == "species")

mammals <- species %>%
  filter(
    Class == "Mammalia",
    !Order %in% c("Chiroptera", "Rodentia", "Peramelemorphia"),
    !Family %in% c("Dasyuridae")
  )

# ── Frogs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
frogs <- species %>%
  filter(Class == "Amphibia")

# ── Birds ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
birds <- species %>%
  filter(Class == "Aves")

# ── Cicadas ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Family Cicadidae within Hemiptera
cicadas <- species %>%
  filter(Family == "Cicadidae")

# ── Crickets & Katydids ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Orthoptera, but excluding grasshoppers (Acrididae) and Pyrgomorphidae
# Katydids = Tettigoniidae
# Crickets = Gryllidae, Gryllacrididae, Gryllotalpidae, Oecanthidae,
#            Phalangopsidae, Trigonidiidae
# Also keeping: Morabidae, Tetrigidae (wingless/ground crickets)

crickets_katydids <- species %>%
  filter(
    Order == "Orthoptera",
    !Family %in% c("Acrididae", "Pyrgomorphidae")
  )

# ── Combine all groups ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
filtered_species <- bind_rows(
  mammals,
  frogs,
  birds,
  cicadas,
  crickets_katydids
)

# Preview counts by group
cat("Mammals (excl. bats, rodents, bilby, dasyurids):", nrow(mammals), "\n")
cat("Frogs:             ", nrow(frogs), "\n")
cat("Birds:             ", nrow(birds), "\n")
cat("Cicadas:           ", nrow(cicadas), "\n")
cat("Crickets/Katydids: ", nrow(crickets_katydids), "\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("Total:             ", nrow(filtered_species), "\n")

# Optional: write to file
write_csv(filtered_species, "filtered_species.csv")
```
